name: Tallgrass — by MacRandle Acres
description: Captures posts from the Facebook groups and profiles you're viewing and sends them to your Tallgrass dashboard, which ranks each post against the median for its own group.
comment_hosts: Chrome match patterns ignore port numbers, so the portless form covers 5050, 5000 and anything else Flask is started on. Pinning :5050 meant a dashboard on any other port silently had no connect script and no way to be reached.

content_scripts.comment: Runs on the dashboard only, so it can hand the extension its endpoint and key with nothing for the user to type or click.
